- Mobile-first, clean white card, rounded corners, green accent (#309D4B)

- Use only the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis)
- No external libraries, APIs, or paid services
- Wrap voice loading in try/catch and show a friendly message if no voices are found
- Reload the voice list on the voiceschanged event

metadata.displayText:
Build a single-file HTML website called "VoiceStudio" with 12 free voice tools. No sign-up, no paid API. Mobile-first, white cards, green accent (#309D4B), rounded corners. Use a top menu (scrollable on mobile) and show one tool at a time. Each tool gets its own section with a short title and one-line description.

TOOLS
1. AI Voice Generator: textarea (500 chars, live counter), sample chips, language and voice dropdowns, speed and pitch sliders, Play/Stop. Use the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis).
2. Text to Speech: same engine, but for long text (up to 5000 chars). Split it into chunks and read them in order, with a progress bar.
3. Realistic Text to Speech: same as above, but list only the best-quality voices (prefer names containing "Neural", "Natural", "Google"), and add a pause control between sentences.
4. Speech Synthesis: show the voice list as cards with name, language, and a "Preview" button.
5. AI Voiceover: script box, split into scenes by blank lines. Each scene has its own voice and speed, with a "Play all" button.
6. Text to MP3: record the speech output (MediaRecorder on a captured audio stream, or the Web Audio API) and give a Download button. Use lamejs from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com to convert to MP3. Show a fallback message if the browser can't capture audio.
7. Speech to Text: a mic button using the SpeechRecognition API, a language selector, live transcript, and Copy and Download .txt buttons.
8. Voice Changer: record or upload audio, then change pitch and speed with the Web Audio API. Add presets (Deep, Chipmunk, Robot, Echo). Play and download the result.
9. AI Voice Enhancer: upload or record audio, then apply high-pass filter, low-pass filter, compressor, and gain with Web Audio. Add a Before/After toggle and a Download button.
10. Voice Conversion: upload audio and apply pitch and formant-style presets (Male, Female, Child). Add a short note that real AI voice conversion needs a server model.
11. Voice Cloning: record 10 seconds of voice, then show clear steps and a button linking to Cartesia's free Playground (https://play.cartesia.ai) for real cloning. Add a note that true cloning needs an AI model.
12. AI Dubbing: upload a video, then play it muted while the user pastes translated text. Read it with speechSynthesis in the chosen language, with a sync button and a speed slider.


RULES
- Only free, built-in browser APIs (speechSynthesis, SpeechRecognition, MediaRecorder, Web Audio). Scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com.
- Wrap every API call in try/catch with friendly error messages (for example, "Please use Chrome").
- Reload voices on the voiceschanged event.
- Everything runs locally and no audio is uploaded anywhere.
- Add a footer note: "Voices depend on your browser and device."


OUTPUT
Return the complete working code in one HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No explanations.

## Objective
- Build a single-file HTML website called VoiceStudio with 12 free, locally running voice tools, then return the complete file without explanations.

## Requirements
- Mobile-first, white cards, rounded corners, green accent `#309D4B`; scrollable mobile menu with one tool visible at a time.
- Implement all 12 specified tools using built-in browser APIs; use lamejs from cdnjs.cloudflare.com only for external scripts.
- Reload speech voices on `voiceschanged`; provide friendly API errors; keep audio local and note browser/device voice dependence.
- No sign-up or paid API; Voice Cloning links to `https://play.cartesia.ai`.

## Decisions
- Text-to-MP3 records microphone audio while speech synthesis plays through speakers because browsers do not expose speechSynthesis audio directly; UI warns that headphones may not be captured.
- Speech-to-Text requires on-device recognition support to avoid browser-managed remote processing.
- Voice Conversion uses local pitch/filter approximations and explains that real AI conversion requires a model.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` containing the 12 tool sections, inline CSS/JS, navigation, voice loading, speech synthesis, audio processing/recording, and requested disclaimers.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode-voicestudio.js` passed before the latest markup edit.

### Active
- Realistic Text to Speech markup now has speed and pitch sliders, but JavaScript value bindings and speech settings still need wiring.
- Review/fix functionality and validate the final HTML/JS after edits.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Wire `speed2`/`pitch2` display updates and apply them to tool 3 utterances.
2. Review tool 8 Before/After toggle so After renders enhanced audio before playback.
3. Re-run inline-script extraction and `node --check`; check remaining tool behavior and finish with `index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation; current work-in-progress.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; repository status showed `index.html` as untracked.
- The script previously passed syntax checking; the latest edit only added tool 3 slider markup, so no final check has occurred since.
